before.note: Abstract: “1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio”; authors report an OpenNeuro release under CC0. The point uses descriptor submission timing; archive upload timing remains unverified. Duration counts simultaneous modalities once; the full manifest remains unenumerated.

after.note: Abstract: “1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio”. In descriptor v2 (November 17, 2026), authors report controlled access through Harvard Dataverse, with voice-masked audio. The point retains initial descriptor submission timing; archive upload timing remains unverified. Version 2 adds current access and duration evidence. Duration counts simultaneous modalities once; the release manifest remains unenumerated.

recordingCoverage.detail: Calculated from descriptor v2 Table 4 recording-hour cells: P01 ≈813.8 h, P02 ≈146.2 h, P03 ≈60.3 h. The shared covert-repetition/listening recordings are counted once.
